item.title: Sophie Kinsella, author of popular ‘Shopaholic’ novels, dies at 55
item.description: Sophie Kinsella, the author of “Confessions of a Shopaholic” and a series of millions-selling sequels, died Monday, her family said. She was 55 and had been diagnosed with brain cancer.

item.title: Ariton woman accused of shooting husband in his sleep to be put in mental hospital ahead of trial
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- A Dale County woman accused of shooting her husband in his sleep will be put in a state mental institution for treatment, court documents reveal.
